audit_method: Same-agent exact comparison against the frozen source, adjacent definitions, formal notation and macro declarations within that revision. No claim about current upstream master is made.

corrections.finding: The editorial sentence contains the malformed phrase ‘is at planning’.
corrections.handling: Translated the contextually clear ‘is planning’ reading and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The subject, infinitival complement and issue reference make the intended present-progressive planning statement unambiguous.

corrections.finding: The remark allows the empty subset even though structures in this edition have nonempty domains.
corrections.handling: Required N to be nonempty and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The edition's first-order structures require a nonempty domain; the induced relational structure construction otherwise works unchanged.

corrections.finding: The target term-value equation uses the source structure's interpretation of f instead of the target structure's interpretation.
corrections.handling: Replaced the mistaken M by M' in that equation and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The equation defines the value of t in M', and the following derivation also uses the M' interpretation.

corrections.finding: The displayed derivation omits the closing parenthesis of the outer h application.
corrections.handling: Restored the closing parenthesis and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The left side and following line both require h to apply to the complete interpreted function value.

corrections.finding: A later parenthetical allows constants although the same file explicitly defines purely relational languages as having predicates only, with neither functions nor constants.
corrections.handling: Made the later parenthetical agree with the earlier explicit definition and added an adjacent keyed note.

mathematical_delta.removed: finitely many predicates and constants, and no functions
mathematical_delta.added: finitely many predicates, and no functions or constants

corrections.controlling_evidence: The theorem immediately above gives the governing in-file definition and the later proposition reuses the same technical phrase.

corrections.finding: The definition reuses n both for the back-and-forth rank and for the independent common sequence length.
corrections.handling: Named the common sequence length k and indexed its variables through x_k, with an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: I_n is defined for sequences of any equal finite length, so their length cannot be fixed to the recursion index n.

corrections.finding: The proof calls the syntactic set of all satisfied bounded-rank formulas finite, while the preceding result gives finiteness only up to logical equivalence.
corrections.handling: Used one representative from each satisfied equivalence class and their finite conjunction, with an adjacent keyed note.

mathematical_delta.removed: the set of all such formulas is finite
mathematical_delta.added: a finite conjunction of equivalence-class representatives

corrections.controlling_evidence: Arbitrarily many syntactically distinct repetitions remain possible at fixed rank; the finite-equivalence-class result supplies exactly the needed finite conjunction.

corrections.finding: The Forth case split omits both the empty partial map and an element already in the map's domain.
corrections.handling: Added the empty-map and already-mapped cases before the remaining order-position cases, with an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The listed below-first, above-last and strictly-between cases require a nonempty map and do not cover equality with an existing domain element.
